name: kineticare
description: Privacy-first, edge-AI physical therapy copilot (local-first, no cloud calls).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run copy:mediapipe-assets && npm run setup:models && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run concurrently -- --names web,server "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "npm --prefix apps/server run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix packages/shared run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.test:e2e: if ls -d ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-* ~/.cache/ms-playwright/firefox-* ~/.cache/ms-playwright/webkit-* 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then npx playwright test; else echo '[e2e] FAILED: no Playwright browser installed; run `npx playwright install chromium` to enable E2E tests' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.verify: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format && npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run build && npm run bundle:sanity && npm run test:e2e && npm run verify:scripts && npm audit --omit=dev
